verdict.rationale: An AI insights layer is a fair question for small-business accounting software, so the axis applies. The pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Auto-categorization of bank transactions, OCR receipt extraction and standard comparison reports are adjacent automation and reporting features, not AI-generated insights or recommendations drawn from the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
